biggest_catch: Reward lapses if the new client doesn't trade ≥€250 or leaves within 6 months; paid to your clearing account after 6 months.
catches: Official referral T&Cs: 'Reward for a successful Scalable Broker recommendation: EUR 25.00' - existing client shares an individual invitation link
New client must open their first Scalable Broker securities account via the link within 6 months and execute trades (savings plans/purchase orders) totaling at least €250 within 6 months of opening
New client must remain a client with positive cash balance for 6 months; the reward is then paid to the existing client's clearing account
Existing client can earn a maximum of 10 rewards (€250 total); participation in a trade/commercial practice is excluded
Identification via Deutsche Post AG or Fourthline B.V., options dependent on residence (German broker)
